readerCopy.body: A small change in the rules can create enough freedom for a previously awkward preference or arrangement to become practical. When Uranus sextiles Lilith, disruption and autonomy cooperate, making an exception, schedule change, unconventional tool, or revised expectation easier to test. The adjustment does not have to become a total rejection of everything familiar. Its value is that one unnecessary restriction stops deciding the whole plan.
